bellaRecommendationInference: Use a new compact OMF projection over validated Bento/OMFI metadata, with shared Bella ID normalization, text decoding, descriptor interpretation, timing arithmetic and Compression naming helpers wherever the actual property form agrees. This is reuse of small verified rules, not reuse of the old scanner or Avid object graph.
Seek the trailing Bento label and validated TOC, then the needed metadata extents; do not read all embedded picture/sound essence into memory merely because PMR/MDB use whole-database buffers.

Candidate retained facts: complete normalized file/master IDs; qualified Clip Name and Project; own descriptor Kind, Length/SampleRate, audio frequency, bit depth/format information, Compression and Resolution; master UsageCode/Type and optional precompute/effect facts only when their owners/evidence are established. Physical Filename/File Path/Size/filesystem dates remain independent.

Original Bin and optional category/effect coverage require actual OMF specimens/property verification; absence stays blank. Do not promise every MDB extension is available in OMF media, and do not infer facts from filename alone.

Choose explicit supported Bento+OMF semantic layouts after the real-file/header review. Ordinary Avid managed-media Bento1.0 and separate OMF2 import capability are evidence, not automatic authorization to implement every OMF interchange workflow.

Detailed text fallback, timing/drop-frame ownership, supported descriptor set, OMF1-vs-OMF2 class/property differences, damage/limits and source-priority policies still need their scoped OMF decisions. Do not treat this capability overview as all those rules approved.

findings.summary: Normal discovery lists admitted .omf/.aif/.wav in managed OMFI folders when enabled, independently of parse success. Byte-based standalone reader acceptance includes nativeRF64/AIFFC, without broadening normal filename/folder admission.

True OMF uses Bento. WAV/AIFF retain native format plus embedded OMF metadata sources. MDB also uses Bento/OMFI vocabulary but has separate current implementation. AVB bins are outside this media-header route.
Tail24-byte Bento label → complete TOC → recorded property ranges and continuations. Needed values can be scattered beforeTOC; no MXF HeaderByteCount or fixed first-N-MiB section.

Current source accepts Bento1.0/2.0 and independently OMF objectrevision1/2. Container order and metadataII/MM separate. OMF1 references8bytes, OMF2 references4bytes; checked typed/order decoding. Extended labels, legacy40bit extension and update resolver unsupported.

metadataOnly skips registered recording properties after resolving property definitions, including continuation segments. It still reads every other deferred value, unknown private metadata included, and creates broad raw/typed object relationships.64KiB scratch does not cap retained metadata. No measured performance/RAM claims.

Qualified OMF can supply file/master IDs, linked masterClipName, _PJProject, OriginalBin, descriptorKind/Length/SampleRate, technicaldepth/raster/codec, masterType/precompute facts. These are capabilities, not promises every file contains every value. Descriptor class coverage extends beyond Bella six-class MDB rule, requiring focused review.

Current raw interpreter strictly decodes four explicitly namedUTF8 properties, directASCII, leaves othernonASCII unknown. Current projection then infers validUTF8 first, elseMacRoman. This is display policy, not producer encoding proof or Bella approval; damaged explicitUTF8 is not same-byte MacRoman fallback.
Current graph can follow _ORG_BIN→MCBR and choose usable nonempty binNameUTF8, then separate legacybinName. Actual presence/availability not established here.

NativeRIFF/RF64WAVE andFORM AIFF/AIFFC chunks are checked; samples skipped. fmt/COMM/ds64 decoded. bext/iXML/axml/umid/minf and other recognised metadata are read raw, without extracting project/clip/FileMobId. Native UMID is not currently FileMobId evidence.

OwnedOMF Duration uses descriptorLength/SampleRate with ownfileEditRate as audio display clock; master/reference length does not replace physical length. NativeuncompressedWAV duration uses a singledataextent/blockAlign; AIFF COMM records sampleframes. Nativeformat does not inventvideoclock. WAVEextensibleprecision differs fromstoragewidth; AIFF80bitsamplerate converted toexactpositivefraction whenrepresentable.

WAVD/AIFD Summary copies audio format fields inside metadata. It is not native physical header. Decode only compatible type/signature; absent sample data is expected. Current code can use Summary facts without reading recording.

Root contents membership and positive physicalMediaDataidentity qualify facts; orphan objects and ambiguous identities do not win by position. Native audio facts survive embeddedgraphdamage/conflict. Current noncancelled partial sources can be projected; do not claim blanketComplete requirement or blanketpartial eligibility.
